nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point. POST from NestJS with the envelope {runId, ownerId, jobId, agentId, payload}. Checks the X-Agora-Secret header and answers 200 at once; the work continues in the background.

nodes.name: Read envelope
nodes.notes: Takes the request body and flattens envelope + payload into one item, so later nodes can read $('Read envelope').first().json.jobId and friends. Stops if runId is missing.

nodes.name: Load job
nodes.notes: Reads the job post, repo URL, base commit and the last spec version.

nodes.name: Repo file URLs
nodes.notes: Builds GitHub API and raw-file URLs from repo_url (public GitHub repos).

nodes.name: Get file tree
nodes.notes: GitHub API: list every file in the repo at the base commit.

nodes.name: Pick files
nodes.notes: Keeps package.json, src/ and test/ files (max 12) so the prompt stays small.

nodes.name: Download files
nodes.notes: Downloads each picked file as text.

nodes.name: Build prompt
nodes.notes: Job text and files go inside <untrusted> tags. Asks for failing tests and an acceptance spec.

nodes.name: Ask LLM
nodes.notes: Calls the lib llm-json sub-workflow: one model call that must return a JSON object with the required keys, or the run fails.

nodes.name: Validate spec
nodes.notes: Code decides: test files must live in test folders, allowed paths may not include tests, default checks from paper Table 6 are filled in.

nodes.name: Run tests on base
nodes.notes: Runs the new tests on the unchanged base commit through the runner.

nodes.name: Must fail on base
nodes.notes: The new tests must FAIL before the fix (else they prove nothing). Sets failsOnBase.

parameters.query:
WITH spec AS (
  INSERT INTO acceptance_specs
    (job_id, version, test_command, build_command, failing_tests, allowed_paths, test_files)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::int, $3, $4,
        ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($5::jsonb)),
        ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($6::jsonb)), $7::jsonb)
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO spec_checks (spec_id, position, name, how_verified, weight)
SELECT spec.id, (c.ord - 1)::smallint, c.v->>'name', c.v->>'howVerified',
       coalesce(c.v->>'weight', 'required')::check_weight
FROM spec, jsonb_array_elements($8::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS c(v, ord)
RETURNING spec_id;

nodes.name: Save spec
nodes.notes: Inserts acceptance_specs (next version, not approved yet) and one spec_checks row per check.

nodes.name: Finish
nodes.notes: Builds one item with the feed message for agent_events and the 'notify' body for NestJS. Messages are written for the owner to read.

nodes.name: Log event
nodes.notes: Calls lib log-event: inserts the row into agent_events (the live activity feed).

nodes.name: Notify Nest
nodes.notes: Calls lib notify-nest: POST /agents/notify so NestJS moves the job to its next step. Errors are ignored, so the agent still works while Nest is not built.
